title: SandpaneSandboxCreateSpec
description: sandbox.create params. Every field is validated in Core before it can reach an SBX CLI argument vector; names follow a strict shell-safe pattern (specs/06 §4).

name.description: Lowercase alphanumeric + single hyphens, alphanumeric ends, no '--' (option-smuggling guard).

workspaceMode.description: direct_mount is live-writable and must be labeled as such in every UI (specs/02 §7).

repoPath.description: Absolute host path of the repository to bind; canonicalized + containment-checked by Core.
